text:
release-coordinator: Starting migration run for tenants.cleanup_v2 — this thread for the concurrent cleanup + backfill step. Plan: canary on 1% traffic, holdpoint at step 3, and pin app version on anomalies. @deploybot please start canary. Window: now -> +2h.

deploybot: Deployment job queued: job_id=jb_20240323_11. Holdpoint step=3. Will post events here.

deploybot: Started canary group 1 -> traffic 1%; running DB job `cleanup/concurrent_delete_v2`; backfill rate=500 rows/sec.

prod-oncall: Observability check: canary cluster latency +2ms, no 5xx so far. Monitoring db.lock.wait_ms = 22ms baseline. Watching. :eyes: 

erin: fyi setting backfill params to be conservative: `--max-rows-per-batch=1000 --sleep-ms=50` and enabling tenant-aware skip. Also recommend `--stop-if-lock>200ms` circuit in the job.

pete: We should pin web-api to v3.8.1 while cleanup runs. v3.9.0 has the schema reader change that might interact poorly with partially-clean data.

sophia: Agree. Abort criteria: lock wait >100ms or error rate >0.5% for 10m. If hit, pause and rollpin.

release-coordinator: Copying abort snippet into thread (runbook):
```bash
# Pause deploybot job
curl -X POST 'https://deploybot.local/api/jobs/jb_20240323_11/pause' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# rollback app if needed
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/web-api --to-revision=3
# abort DB cleanup safely (cancel job queries)
psql -c 'SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE ''%concurrent_delete_v2%'';'
```

deploybot: canary metrics update: deleted ~24k rows so far, avg batch=800 rows, lock_wait_avg=28ms, job_id=jb_20240323_11.

prod-oncall: :warning: seeing lock_wait spike on shard-3: 320ms and 2 queries waiting (correlated with tenant X long-running report).

erin: Confirming correlation with tenant X. Suggest immediate throttle: `--sleep-ms=300` for shard-3 and pause tenant X traffic routing for the canary.

pete: Strong +1 to pause. This is risky to continue with public traffic. Recommend pause cleanup and pin API now, then re-run in maintenance window.

release-coordinator: Decision checklist: pause migration, pin web-api to v3.8.1, record incident & resume window = 2024-03-24 01:00 UTC. Steps executed below.

deploybot: Pausing job jb_20240323_11 now. status=paused. pinned api image web-api:v3.8.1 on prod (image tag applied).

sophia: Noted and adding short release note: "Concurrent cleanup paused due to lock spike on shard-3; will resume in scheduled maintenance window after tenant-aware gating added."

prod-oncall: After pause, lock_wait returned to baseline ~24ms. Continuing to monitor for any residual effects.

release-coordinator: Follow-ups: (1) open PR to add tenant-aware gating to cleanup job (skip heavy tenants by default), (2) add `--stop-if-lock>100ms` threshold and circuit breaker, (3) schedule a dry-run in the 01:00 UTC window. I'll file the ticket and link here.

deploybot: job jb_20240323_11 status=paused, queued_actions=[pin-image:web-api:v3.8.1].

release-coordinator: Closing thread — migration paused and pinned. Will reconvene at the 01:00 UTC window with updated gating. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
